integrity: The path-power minimum and ordinary-path random-set theory are credited as prior work. Numerical checks are finite diagnostics; infinite assertions follow from the supplied proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed forcing radius and independent Bernoulli seeds on path powers; generality to growing radius or other graph families is not claimed. Classical Poisson local-pattern convergence is used, and independent mathematical assessment remains pending.
title: A sharp Poisson window for random zero forcing on powers of paths
